user.title: Hoval Connect
user.description: Enter your Hoval Connect account credentials.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Hoval Connect
reauth_confirm.description: Your session has expired. Please re-enter your credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Hoval Connect. Please try again later.
error.wrong_account: This login is for a different account. Re-authenticate with the same email used to set up the integration.

data_description.turn_on_mode: What happens when the fan is turned on from standby.
data_description.override_duration: How long a manual fan speed change lasts before the time program resumes.
data_description.health_check_interval: How often to check that the Hoval cloud API is reachable. Does not affect how quickly writes (program changes, temperature changes) take effect.

reset_ww_boost.name: Reset hot water boost
reset_ww_boost.description: Cancels any active temporary hot water temperature adjustment and immediately resumes the active week program. This is the same action as pressing 'reset' in the Hoval app. Safe to call when no override is active.
